purpose: A named reference Generator yields an initialized owning Cache CV, then unsets the old cache and received-argv names before supplied body Stop. After the producer clears the sole receiver CV, the real yielded cell keeps Cache through actual argv destruction; supplied replacement Stop preserves Previous/original traces, caller cleanup and result sentinel, then Cache and Generator retire.
source:
<?php
class Stop120R extends Exception {}
class Cache120R {
    function __destruct() {
        global $weakTarget, $weakArgument, $weakCache;
        echo 'CACHE|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakArgument->get() === null, '|', $weakCache->get() === $this, '|';
    }
}
class Argument120R {
    function __construct() { global $weakArgument; $weakArgument = WeakReference::create($this); }
    function __destruct() {
        global $weakTarget, $weakCache, $replacementStop;
        echo 'ARG|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakCache->get() instanceof Cache120R, '|';
        $probe = new Exception('probe'); $trace = $probe->getTrace();
        echo 'TRACE|', $trace[0]['function'] === '__destruct', '|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Argument120R', '|', $trace[1]['function'] === 'run120R', '|', !isset($trace[2]), '|';
        unset($trace, $probe); throw $replacementStop;
    }
}
function &flow120R() {
    global $bodyStop, $weakCache;
    $cache = new Cache120R; $weakCache = WeakReference::create($cache);
    try { $received = yield $cache; unset($received); unset($cache); echo 'BODY|'; throw $bodyStop; }
    finally {
        global $weakTarget, $weakArgument;
        echo 'FIN|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakCache->get() instanceof Cache120R, '|', $weakArgument->get() instanceof Argument120R, '|';
    }
}
function argument120R() {
    global $target, $weakTarget, $weakCache; $target = null;
    echo 'HELD|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakCache->get() instanceof Cache120R, '|';
    return new Argument120R;
}
function run120R() {
    global $target, $weakTarget, $weakArgument, $weakCache, $bodyStop, $replacementStop;
    $target = flow120R(); $target->current(); $weakTarget = WeakReference::create($target); $result = 'sentinel';
    try { $result = $target->send(argument120R()); echo 'BAD-RETURN|'; }
    catch (Stop120R $caught) {
        echo 'CATCH|', $caught === $replacementStop, '|', $caught->getPrevious() === $bodyStop, '|', $bodyStop->getPrevious() === null, '|', $caught->getTrace() === [], '|', $bodyStop->getTrace() === [], '|', $weakTarget->get() === null, '|', $weakArgument->get() === null, '|', $weakCache->get() === null, '|', $result === 'sentinel', '|';
    }
}
$bodyStop = new Stop120R('body'); $replacementStop = new Stop120R('argv'); run120R(); echo 'DONE|';
